beats.say: Deadline reveals The Gilded Age returns with 8 episodes.
The fourth season will premiere on Sunday 1 November.
Deadline reports it airs in the 9 p.m. slot.
The hit drama streams directly on HBO Max.
The platform first launched in the United States back on 27 May 2020.
Deadline confirms all eight episodes will arrive for this brand new chapter.
Will you be tuning in on Sunday 1 November?
